text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
The day has finally come, Akebono! We're 
doin' it again this year, right...?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Your birthday sumo bout, of course!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Waaah~♪ Really?\nI get to have it this 
year too~!?"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Pokke and the kids from 'L/Roars' seemed 
really frustrated by last year's defeat. 
Apparently, they've spent the past year 
practicing every spare moment they had.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Will you accept my challenge, Akebono? 
I'll prepare everything in grand 
fashion—from the referee to the tournament 
itself!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Yeah, same here! And once it's over—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Leave the chanko party preparations to me. 
I'll gather all your favorites, Akebono.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hah, already talking about after the 
race...? I'm gonna scoop-throw that 
cockiness right out of ya...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yep, yep, hit me with everything you've 
got! No matter how hard you charge in, 
bring it on♪

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!? Looks like you're still in top 
shape...! That invincible aura...!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Still, this year I'm definitely handing 
you a defeat! Consider that my birthday 
present to you!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yeah♪ ...Yeah!! Let's make some buono 
memories~♪

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Now, will this be the year the rankings 
get turned upside down!? ...Stay tuned to 
find out♪
